measures.title: Parks, Sports, Recreational Facilities and Botanical Gardens to be Financed by General Obligation Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether Palm Beach County should issue up to $280,000,000 in general obligation bonds, maturing within 20 years and repaid from property taxes on all taxable property in the county. The money would modernize aging parks, recreation facilities and botanical gardens, expand and update sports complexes, increase public beach access and trail connections, and develop new regional parks.
measures.yesMeans: The County may issue up to $280 million in bonds for parks and recreation, repaid from countywide property taxes.
measures.noMeans: The County may not issue these bonds.

measures.title: Referendum to Continue Ad Valorem Levy for School Safety, Teachers and Operational Needs
measures.summary: Asks whether the School District of Palm Beach County should keep its authority to levy 1.00 mill of property tax for public school operating needs from July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2031. The money is dedicated to school safety, school police, mental health services, arts, music, physical education, career and choice program teachers, and improved teacher pay, with oversight by an independent citizens committee.
measures.yesMeans: The School District continues its 1.00 mill property tax for these purposes from July 2027 through June 2031.
measures.noMeans: The School District does not continue this 1.00 mill property tax after its current authority ends.
